scope: 36 dated BLS Employment Situation releases, Jan 2022-Dec 2024
limits: Wage percent is blank when not stated in the archived prose; cents and level remain printed values, not calculations from another release.
Prior-month wage levels can be revised within a new release. Do not compute a current wage change from separate release vintages.
Original first web-publication time/bytes are unauthenticated.
